subject: general
question: Who among the following became the President of Indian National Congress, a political party, in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **Mallikarjun Kharge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mallikarjun Kharge** became the **President of the Indian National Congress** in October 2022.

 
 
• He **defeated Shashi Tharoor **in the 2022 Indian National Congress presidential election.
 
• He is a senior Congress leader from Karnataka who has previously served as the Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha and the Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
 
• He has served as the Minister of Railways and the Minister of Labour and Employment in the Government of India.
 
• He has been **a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha from Karnataka since 2020.**
